description: Complete rewrite of MainMenu.tsx to implement a Windows 7 Aero desktop-style main menu, replacing the 3D Three.js scene with pure CSS/HTML
steps: Remove all Three.js imports and the entire MenuScene component from src/components/MainMenu.tsx
Implement the Windows 7 desktop background using a CSS gradient that simulates the classic Win7 blue/green aurora wallpaper

Implement desktop icons grid with large icons (using emoji/unicode) and labels: 'Редактор карт' (folder icon, calls onOpenEditor), 'Серверы' (network icon, opens servers panel), 'Настройки' (gear icon, opens settings panel), 'JailBreak Story' (film icon, opens cutscene viewer)

Implement the taskbar at the bottom: translucent dark bar with backdrop-filter blur (Aero glass), a 'Пуск' start button with orb styling on the left, a clock showing current time and volume icon on the right
Implement the Start Menu that opens when clicking 'Пуск': Win7-style panel with left column (Редактор карт, Серверы, Настройки, Выход items) and right column (Все программы, user avatar area at top)

Restyle SettingsPanel to look like a Windows 7 Control Panel window: title bar with Aero glass effect, close/minimize/maximize buttons (red X etc.), rounded corners (8px), shadow, keep same functionality (sound volume slider, graphics quality low/medium/high, controls list)
Restyle ServersPanel to look like a Windows 7 window with same glass effects, title bar buttons, and rounded corners

Implement a cutscene viewer component: slideshow of styled div frames (dark background + centered text describing prison story scenes), auto-advances every few seconds with fade transitions. Scenes: arrival at prison, cell assignment, meeting inmates, planning escape. Opens from desktop icon or can play as background
Add all necessary CSS animations and keyframes for window open/close, hover effects on desktop icons, taskbar button glow, start menu slide-up
Ensure the MainMenu component exports with the same interface: MainMenuProps { onOpenEditor: () => void } and keeps the QualitySettings import for the settings panel
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without TypeScript errors
No Three.js imports remain in MainMenu.tsx
MainMenu exports with the same MainMenuProps interface
Desktop shows Windows 7 aurora-style gradient background
Desktop icons are displayed in a grid with emoji icons and text labels
Taskbar at bottom has Aero glass blur effect with start button and clock
Start menu opens/closes on Пуск button click
Settings panel styled as Win7 window with title bar, close button, and glass effect
Servers panel styled as Win7 window with same styling
Cutscene viewer shows sequence of text frames with fade transitions
All interactive elements (desktop icons, start menu items) trigger correct actions
verification: Run 'npm run build' from the game folder and confirm successful compilation with no errors
